data.name: Half Day Forest Kayaking Ban Bo Tho (Private)
data.description: At the head of Phang Nga Bay is where you'll find the tiny fishing community of Bor Tor. It is slightly closer to Krabi than Phuket, and one may get there by road from any of those two places. You can find limestone karsts near the pier, in the middle of the mangroves. The cave's limestone walls are full of indigenous palms and cycads for a stunning look. Onward and upward from Thom Lod, we have the "Pee Hua Tor" cave, also known as the "large-headed ghost cave," which can be reached by canoe in just a few minutes. Because of the abnormally colossal size of the human skull that discoverers found here, this location got its name. You may see more evidence of ancient occupation in the cave's roughly one hundred pictographs distributed around the cave's roof and walls. Richochre is used to illustrate both historical figures, fantastical creatures, and humans in yellow and black pigments. Additionally, large amounts of shells are in the sedimentary rock and littering the cave floor. Some of these shells may be part of middles, which are the rubbish and refuse left behind by prehistoric cave dwellers

data.description: Visit the pristine island of Phang Nga Bay from Krabi, where adventure and thrill-seeking water activities await in James Bond Island. The gorgeous island is widely known as one of the film sets for the James Bond movie, The Man with the Golden Gun, filmed in 1974 and starred Roger Moore. To this day, the island's emerald sea, towering isles coated in lush vegetation, and well-preserved beaches, caves, and villages are still intact, heavenly, and beautiful – just like in the Bond film. Hop in on a relaxing long-tail boat ride and sightsee your way to the island's attractions including Suwannakhuha Temple, Panyee village, and Lot Cave. data.description:

You’ll be picked up from your Krabi and Ao Nang area hotel and taken to Nang An Pier to board the boat. The first stop is at Tup Island, where you can snorkel at high tide, or walk across the sand bank to Chicken Island, the next stop, at low tide. Snorkel at Chicken Island or explore its rock formations.

At Poda Island, sunbathe on the white sand beach, play in the water, and tuck into the provided picnic lunch. At the last stop, Phra Nang Cave on Railay Beach, admire the stalactites, stalagmites, and offerings in the cave.

The tour concludes with the boat ride back to Nang An Pier and drop-off at your hotel.

data.description:

During high season, meet in front of the Railay Village Resort & Spa on Railay West Beach 30 minutes before departure time. During low season, meet at the floating pier in front of the Sunrise Tropical Resort & Spa on Railay East Beach to take a longtail beach to the ferry.

data.name: 2-Hour The best of Krabi Private Walking Tour
data.description:
Together with the professional guide, you will visit the most charming places in the city. Why is Krabi known as one of the most visited holiday destinations in the World? What is so fascinating about this place? From picturesque tropical islands to pristine natural parks, there’s a lot for you to see in Krabi.

You will have a chance to explore the city while hearing fascinating facts and legends. Have you heard of the beautiful "Koh Poda"? Why does it attract millions of visitors around the world? Krabi is well-known for being an area of outstanding natural beauty. You will be surprised how many stories are hidden in the streets, buildings, and corners of Krabi. Your charming guide will tell you what is special and unique about living in this city. Perfect for those who are visiting the city for the first time and want to get the most of it!

data.name: Tremendous Rock Climbing paradise at Railay beach, Krabi
data.description:
#Spend the day discovering a rock climbing paradise on this excursion that's perfect for beginners. After learning introductory top roping skills, ascend spectacular limestone cliffs, rappel from a stunning viewpoint, and venture into caverns for a caving expedition.

- Spectacular limestone cliffs of beautiful Railay Beach

- Magnificent views of Krabi & the surrounding Andaman Sea

- Professional & certified instructor teaches essential skills

- Chance to go caving & rappel from a stunning viewpoint

- Perfect introduction to rock climbing for all ages

data.name: Discover Krabi: Private City Tour Adventure
data.description: Experience Krabi in style and comfort with a private tour tailored to your group. Avoid the busy tourist buses and enjoy the freedom of exploring at your own leisure. Discover Krabi's hidden gems and iconic landmarks with a personalized itinerary.

data.name: Dragon Crest Hike, ATV, and Kayaking Full-Day Private Tour
data.description: Spend an adventure-filled day featuring kayaking, hiking, and ATV-riding with this private, guided experience. You'll hike up Dragon Crest Mountain to take in fantastic views, go on a thrilling ATV ride across rugged terrain, and paddle a kayak through a beautiful lagoon, with time left over to take a refreshing dip.

data.name: James Bond Island Day trip with Cannoing Lunch
data.description: A Day Trip to "James Bond Island" Pick up from the hotel and transfer to the pier (round transfer) At Hong Island you can enjoy Canoeing through the cave and among the mangrove forest. Visit Panyee Island the sea gypsies village. Have lunch at the restaurant. Visit Khao Phing Kan and James Bond Island (where the film James Bond 007 was filmed.) Visit Panak Island, Sightseeing around the island, Explorer the Ice Cream Cave or the mangrove cave. At Naka Island enjoy swimming, relaxing on the beach, paddle board.

data.name: Ao Nang Krabi Thai Boxing Stadium Admission Ticket with Return Transfer
data.description:
Ao Nang Krabi Stadium behind Nopparat Thara Beach is the largest Muay Thai venue in southern Thailand and puts on regular Thai boxing bouts on a smaller scale, every Friday night. If you would like to see this astonishing sport live, this is the place to come in Krabi. Matches are all about spectacle: a complex dance ceremony is performed before each fight to pay respect to the combattants’ teachers and to the guardian spirit of Thai boxing.

However, they are not ‘for show’, as in some tourist areas – they are real fights, regularly attended by local Thai fans

data.name: Ultimate ATV Ride and Kayaking Experience from Krabi
data.description: Get ready for the ultimate adventure with an exhilarating ATV ride near Ao Nang! Conquer rugged terrains and navigate winding paths, all just minutes from the stunning Ao Nang coastline. Feel the rush as you power through dirt trails surrounded by Krabi’s lush landscapes, exploring off-the-beaten-path areas with breathtaking views. After the adrenaline of the ride, unwind with a serene kayaking journey through the crystal-clear waters of Klong Root, a hidden freshwater canal nestled in a lush peat swamp forest. Paddle past rare orchids, exotic plants, and ancient trees, immersing yourself in the untouched beauty of this tranquil oasis. Ideal for thrill-seekers and nature lovers alike, this tour offers an unforgettable day in Krabi.

data.name: Cheow Lan Lake Adventure from Krabi with Cave and Floating Lunch
data.description: You simply can’t miss the once-in-a-lifetime beauty of Cheow Lan Lake—where emerald-green waters stretch beneath towering mountain cliffs and the rainforest hums with life. Glide across the lake as reflections dance like a dream, hear gibbons calling in the distance, and feel the mist kiss your skin. Swim in crystal-clear depths, kayak through peaceful stretches surrounded by greenery, and indulge in a Thai feast at a floating restaurant. Hike into the rainforest to uncover a mystical cave. This intimate, sensory journey is perfect for those who seek the extraordinary—because missing out on Cheow Lan Lake is simply not an option.

data.name: Best of Phi Phi Islands, Maya Bay Snorkeling Tour from Krabi
data.description: Spend the day basking in the sun, swimming, and snorkeling on Thailand's most picturesque beaches with this tour from Krabi to the Phi Phi Islands. Visit the breathtaking Pileh Bay, encircled by majestic limestone cliffs, and explore Maya Bay, renowned as the filming location for 'The Beach.' Departing earlier than standard tours, this trip ensures you can enjoy popular spots and snorkeling areas before the crowds arrive, offering a more serene and unforgettable experience.

data.name: Koh Yao Yai: Speed Boat transfer from Railay Beach
data.description: Turn a travel day into a day of adventure. Save time by journeying from Railay Beach to Koh Yao Yai by speedboat. You'll have a short stopover in Ao Nang and Koh Yao Noi and get dropped off at Chong Lad Pier in the north of Koh Yao Yai from where you can take a taxi to your hotel.

data.name: Four Islands Speedboat Trip from Krabi
data.description: The ultimate 4 Islands Tour with Krabi Muk Andaman Travel! Explore stunning islands with local guides, enjoy speedy speedboats, capture perfect photos, and experience top-notch service all day long!

data.name: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat From Krabi with Lunch
data.description: Join this group tour to the gorgeous Phi Phi islands, where all of the details are arranged for you, so you just need to enjoy the day out. You’ll begin with hotel pickup to keep things easy, and then you’ll make your way to your speedboat for the day. Visit several islands, snorkel, swim, explore, and relax over the course of the day.

data.name: Krabi Small Group Rock Climbing Tour at Railay Beach
data.description: Climb the limestone rock faces and cliffs of Krabi’s Railay Beach on this small group climbing tour. All of your gear is provided for you, and an instructor will be with you the entire time. You can choose either a half or full day of climbing, depending on your interests. If you choose the full day, you’ll have lunch provided to keep you energized.

data.name: Sea Kayaking Adventure at Ao Thalane Bay from Krabi (SHA Plus)
data.description:
Head out to Ao Thalane, a small fishing village in the heart of Krabi, for a leisurely tour in a kayak suitable for all ages and skill levels. Explore the beauty hidden within the local mangrove ecosystem and pass through gorgeous bays, canyons, and caves on this morning adventure.

- Discovering gorgeous Ao Thalane's wildlife & scenery

- Kayak tour along the hidden gems of Krabi's mangrove habitat

- Chance to see splendid bays, canyons & limestone cliffs

- Informative kayaking lesson from a knowledgeable guide

- Opportunity to see unique crab-eating macaques by the shore

data.name: Phi Phi Islands Premium Trip By Royal Jet Cruiser and Speedboat From Phuket
data.description:
• Enjoy the picturesque sights of the famous Phi Phi Islands and its surroundings by Royal Jet Cruiser.

• Cruise passing by Phi Phi Ley Island for Sightseeing on board such as Viking Cave, Pi Leh Cove, Loh Samah Bay, Maya Bay.

• Relax in the cushioned comfort of the Premium Class seating.

• Enjoy exclusive use of a private sundeck

• Snorkel the beautiful island waters from a luxury speedboat (free gear rental included).

• Relax on the white sand beach, swim in crystal clear water at Phi Phi Don Island.

• Savor a delicious buffet and sumptuous seafood for lunch Receive complimentary beverages and snacks.

• Enjoy convenient transfers to and from your hotel.

data.name: Krabi City Tour with Reclining Buddha, Tiger Cave Temple
data.description:
Go around Krabi and then get to visit Wat Tham Sua (Tiger Cave Monastery), a quiet secluded spot where Buddhist monks practice meditation. Their living quarters are very small huts or caves in the interior of a ring of tree-covered cliffs shaped rather like a doughnut, which is reached by a short climb via well-made concrete steps leading up the outside and down to the central inner area. Another place you will get to visit is Hat Noppharat Thara, one of Krabi's most beautiful beaches.

- Visit to Wat Tam Sue (Tiger Cave Temple), Sightseeing & trekking to the cave

- Arrive to Krabi town, visit to The Symbol of Krabi “Khao Kanap Nam”

- Do some shopping at Krabi local Market.

- Visit to Nopparat Thara Marine National park

- Free hotel pick up & drop off (selected hotel only)

data.name: Private Longtail Boat Charter to Stunning 4 Islands
data.description:
Explore the stunning islands of the Andaman coast on a private boat charter. Snorkel, sightseeing on beautiful sandy beaches of Krabi. See unique rock formations of Chicken head, and a sandbank that connects to Chicken Island.

Be picked up from your hotel in Ao Nang, Krabi Town, or Klong Muang areas. Board a private boat and head to the first stop, Chicken Island. Snorkel in the perfect spot and see the unique rock formation that gives the island its name.

Next, head to Poda Island. Walk along the white sandy beach to find a good spot to relax or swim. Continue to Tub Island, which is situated next to Chicken Island.

The last stop is Railay Beach. Here, you can reach Pranang Cave 10 minute walk. On this private boat, feel free to decide by yourself to choose or stay longer on your favorite spot. Relax on the beach or snorkel without a guide to rush you.

Pick up time can be flexible from 7.30 earliest till 9.30 in morning please tell us after booking about your prefer pick up time.

data.name: Krabi: Thai Cooking Class With Local Market
data.description: Rather than just leaving Thailand with memories of great food, learn to cook it yourself after a cooking class in Krabi. Not only will you create signature dishes that you won't typically find in restaurants, but you'll also overcome the language barrier at a local market with the help of your guide.

data.name: Krabi City Tour Sunset
data.description: This tour offers an exciting combination of nature, culture, and relaxation, making it an unforgettable experience for visitors to Krabi and letting you know Krabi like a local.

data.name: Krabi James Bond Island Boat Tour with Lunch and Kayak Option
data.description:
Go island hopping in Phang Nga Bay and visit an island made famous by a James Bond movie on this full-day tour from Krabi. Visit multiple islands with ease, with round-trip transfers, lunch and refreshments, national park fees, and insurance all included.

Get picked up in the morning from your Krabi area accommodations by air-conditioned vehicle and head to Surakul Pier to board a large longtail boat to Phang Nga Bay.

Explore James Bond Island, made famous by the movie, “”The Man with the Golden Gun.”” At the next stop, Thalu Island, go for an optional guided kayak tour through mangroves and caves. Break for lunch at Panyee Floating Village, with free time to explore afterwards.

After returning to Surakul Pier, travel by land to the Monkey Cave Temple for a short visit, then continue on to Raman Waterfalls. End the tour with drop-off at your Krabi accommodations.

data.name: Krabi Countryside Eco Cycling Tour - Multiple Trails
data.description: Explore back roads and narrow tracks on a half-day mountain bike tour of Krabi’s countryside. Leave the city behind for small fishing and farming communities, and pedal through tranquil valleys beneath soaring cliffs. Climb into verdant hills and descend along winding single track, pass unspoiled forests home to thriving monkeys and vivid birds, and discover Krabi’s astonishing landscape at your own pace.

data.name: Krabi 4 Islands Tour and Snorkeling with Shared boat
data.description: Krabi Day Trip with beautiful natural attractions which is called Amazing Unseen Thailand. You will enjoy with snorkeling, swimming with schools of fish and walk along the sandy beaches that connect the three islands. You can see the phenomenon of the sea breaking which is the most unseen Thailand of Krabi and experience the white sandy beach that stretches like a bridge that connects three islands. That can be walked from one island to another at low tide. Also swimming, snorkeling and witching fish and pray at Phra Nang Cave to observe a famous rock climbing.

data.name: Hong Island Romantic Sunset Group Tour and Barbeque Dinner
data.description: Watch the sunset with your sweetheart at Hong Island on this romantic tour. You’ll keep costs down by going with the group, but still have plenty of time to enjoy the island on your own. Sip on included cocktails when you arrive, snorkel, swim, walk on the beach, and sit down to an included seafood barbeque dinner.

data.name: Hong Islands Sunset and Bioluminescent Plankton Tour
data.description: Swim, snorkel, and sightsee in the Hong Islands with stops for dinner and swimming among bioluminescent plankton with this tour. You'll visit the Hong Island Lagoon by longtail boat, hang out on sandy beaches, snorkel among tropical fish, and get the chance to go on a night swim among bioluminescent plankton, all with an English-speaking guide to lead the way.

data.name: Krabi Discovery Half Day Tour
data.description: The Krabi Discovery Half Day Tour by Travstore is an ideal way to explore the highlights of Krabi in a short amount of time. This guided tour typically includes visits to iconic landmarks such as the Tiger Cave Temple, with its stunning panoramic views, and the peaceful Wat Kaew Korawaram Temple, known for its beautiful white marble architecture. The tour is designed to offer a balance of cultural insights, historical significance, and natural beauty, all while being relaxed and informative. It’s perfect for those looking to experience Krabi’s most famous sites without committing to a full day of touring.

data.name: Krabi Flavors Morning Food Walking Tour
data.description:
Discover the culinary delights of Krabi Town on this engaging morning food walking tour. Sample over 10 local dishes as you explore vibrant markets and hidden eateries, guided by an expert who shares insights into Thai cuisine's rich history. Stroll through charming streets adorned with colorful murals and iconic landmarks, making every corner a photo opportunity. From traditional Thai breakfasts to unique Southern specialties, this 3.5-hour journey promises a true taste of Krabi's food scene. Perfect for food lovers and cultural enthusiasts alike, this tour accommodates up to 8 guests and includes all tastings at four different stops.

- 3.5-hour guided walking tour through Krabi Town

- Taste over 10 authentic Thai dishes at 4 unique food stops

- Maximum group size of 8 for a personalized experience

- Immerse yourself in local culture with insights from knowledgeable guides

data.name: Snorkeling at the 7 Barbecue Islands and Sunset
data.description:
This tour offers much more than just a sightseeing tour: it is a complete immersion in the wild beauty of Krabi. In one day, you explore islands with varied landscapes – between white sandy beaches, spectacular rock formations, snorkelling in crystal clear waters – until you experience a rare and magical moment: swimming in the heart of the night with bioluminescent plankton.

This mix of adventure, relaxation, unspoilt nature and night magic makes this activity unique, authentic and unforgettable.

data.name: Krabi To Surat Thani Town
data.description: Daily trips all year round from Krabi to Surat Thani Town with a convenient hotel pickup service in Ao Nam Mao, Ao Nang and Krabi Town. Get a direct Van or Bus without stopover from the center in  Krabi Town  to Surat Thani Town in 2 and half hours.

data.name: White Water Rafting Adventure Tour From Krabi
data.description: Plunge into the exhilarating rapids of the Song Phreak River on an unforgettable rafting tour through the heart of Phang Nga’s lush landscapes. Feel the adrenaline surge as you navigate thrilling white water with expert guides, surrounded by breathtaking tropical scenery. Beyond rafting, enjoy exciting activities like ziplining through the forest canopy on a flying fox. Explore the iconic Suwan Khuha Temple, known as the “Monkey Cave Temple,” and enhance your adventure with optional jungle trekking or ATV rides. Perfect for families, couples, solo travelers, and groups, this tour offers fun for all skill levels. With round-trip hotel transfers included, your day of excitement is effortless from start to finish.
